cohort: The study participants were live births in Brazil registered in the Live Birth Information System between 2012 and 2022.
finding: The prevalence of Congenital Heart Disease (CHD) in Brazil was 7.65 per 10,000 live births between 2012 and 2022, showing an increasing temporal trend across all regions.
mod_finding: The prevalence of CHD was higher in pregnancies with deliveries by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Affected neonates in the study were predominantly extremely low birth weight.
gest_age: Affected neonates in the study were predominantly preterm.
